title: Build an Opaque Cache
prompt: Implement a tiny fixed-size cache behind an opaque API: `cache_t *cache_create(size_t cap)`, `int cache_put(cache_t *c, int key, int value)` (returns 1 stored, 0 full), `int *cache_get(cache_t *c, int key)` (returns NULL on miss). Keep the struct definition in your source; the tests only use the functions — that is the opacity contract.

tests.name: put then get
tests.hint: Store then retrieve through the handle; the caller never sees the layout.

tests.name: miss is NULL
tests.hint: A fresh cache; absent keys must return NULL, not garbage.

tests.name: full is rejected
tests.hint: cap is respected: the fifth insert reports 0.

tests.name: update keeps capacity
tests.hint: Updating an existing key must succeed on a FULL cache — an update must not consume a new slot.
